title: Tech Community & Activation Intern
description:
Artificial Intelligence is transforming the corporate landscape at an unprecedented pace. Today, every major enterprise and rising professional in Indonesia is racing to build an AI-literate workforce. Algoritma stands at the forefront of this revolution as the premier destination for data science and AI education.

We are expanding our ecosystem and are looking for an ambitious, high-energy
Tech Community & Activation Intern
who thrives on human connection and creative storytelling. If you possess the vibrant communication skills to engage tech enthusiasts, the organizational skills to run seamless events, and the drive to build a thriving AI community, this internship is built for you.

Your Focus Areas

Support Event Operations
: Assist in the end-to-end coordination of virtual workshops and in-person networking events. You will manage platform logistics, coordinate with speakers, and ensure our attendees have an unforgettable learning experience.

Create Buzzworthy Content
: Transform the insights and key takeaways from our workshops into engaging social media posts, stories, and short videos. You will help maintain our content calendar and keep our brand top-of-mind.

Engage the Community Daily
: Actively monitor and spark conversations across our community channels. You will welcome new members, answer questions, and build a welcoming space for data science and AI enthusiasts.

Coordinate Ecosystem Partnerships
: Reach out to university student organizations, tech communities, and potential partners to coordinate promotional collaborations and expand Algoritma's reach.

title: Enterprise Account Manager for AI Training & Consulting
description:
Artificial Intelligence is transforming the corporate landscape at an unprecedented pace. Today, every major enterprise in Indonesia is racing to build AI literate workforce. Algoritma stands at the forefront of this revolution as the premier destination for data science and AI education.

We are expanding our Enterprise Solutions team and are looking for an ambitious, high energy Enterprise Account Manager who thrives on new business acquisition. If you possess the refined communication skills to engage C level executives, the resilience to master cold outreach, and the drive to close high impact corporate deals, this role is built for you.

Manage the Complete Sales Lifecycle
: Own the deal from the initial cold introduction to the final contract signature, working closely with our teams to present tailored upskilling solutions.

title: Midd. iOS Developer
description:
Job Requirements - iOS Developer

Minimum 4 years of experience in iOS mobile application development.

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Strong proficiency in Swift is a must.

Experience using React Native is considered a plus.

Experience in handling banking or financial services projects is highly preferred.

Solid understanding of iOS platform guidelines, mobile UI/UX best practices, and performance optimization.

Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs and backend services.

Basic knowledge of iOS build, deployment, and debugging processes is an advantage.

Familiar with version control tools such as Git.

Ability to work closely with backend developers, QA, and project stakeholders.

Willingness to learn banking systems, security standards, and compliance requirements.

Strong problem-solving skills and effective communication abilities.

title: Telesales Property Acquisition
description:
🔥 Tanggung Jawab Utama

1️⃣ Lead Handling & Verification

Menangani 90% inbound leads dari iklan.

Melakukan verifikasi data unit (harga, legalitas, kondisi unit, alasan jual).

Meminta dan mengumpulkan dokumen pendukung dari owner.

Maintain database supply dan update status secara berkala.

2️⃣ Price Analysis & Market Research

Melakukan riset harga pasar melalui marketplace (OLX, Lamudi, Rumah123, dll).

Membandingkan harga listing vs harga transaksi realistis.

Mengidentifikasi unit yang berpotensi below market.

Memberikan rekomendasi harga penawaran berdasarkan margin target.

3️⃣ Negotiation & Deal Structuring

Melakukan negosiasi harga dengan owner.

Memahami dan menghitung biaya-biaya transaksi:

Pajak (PPH, BPHTB)

Anggaran notaris, administrasi apartemen, renovasi ringan

Memastikan deal yang diambil masih sesuai target margin perusahaan.

4️⃣ Coordination & Survey

Menjadwalkan survey unit dengan tim surveyor.

Follow-up hasil survey dan update status.

Koordinasi internal sebelum unit diputuskan untuk diambil.

5️⃣ Active Hunting (Jika Inbound Slow)

Hunting manual di marketplace.

Membangun relasi dengan agent eksternal.

Mengumpulkan informasi unit distress / butuh cepat.
